summary: [standards] ingest_removal_05_rewriting_the_same_run_is_not_an_error_and_other_content_is_a_new_version proves the second Then step only by rows.len()==1 after a write with another actor model: it passes if that write is silently dropped or silently overwrites the first, which is what 'a new version... nothing is overwritten silently' excludes. It never checks that two kind=run objects exist (the run_objects helper is in the same module, unused here) or that the fold returns the newer model. One-line mutation that should fail it: make persist_run skip a run whose id is already stored; the test stays green. Blast radius: the identical-bytes half (no error, no second row) is proven and is the half dispatch end relies on.
